entries.name: Claude Inspired Design System
entries.vibe: Warm editorial clarity with terracotta accents, calm whitespace, and thoughtful reading rhythm.
entries.palette_notes: Use warm neutrals, parchment-like surfaces, dark ink text, and a restrained terracotta accent for primary actions and highlights.
entries.typography_notes: Favor highly readable text with literary contrast between display headlines and comfortable body copy.
entries.layout_notes: Prefer generous breathing room, asymmetric editorial sections, and clean reading columns.
entries.component_notes: Buttons and cards should feel calm and trustworthy; emphasize conversation surfaces, side panels, and annotation-friendly containers.

entries.name: Vercel Inspired Design System
entries.vibe: Monochrome precision with exact spacing, crisp typography, and infrastructure-grade confidence.
entries.palette_notes: Use near-black, white, and neutral grays as the base; reserve color for tiny status moments, code states, or accent gradients.
entries.typography_notes: Favor compact sans typography with strong hierarchy and low ornamentation.
entries.layout_notes: Use strict grids, measured gutters, and sections that feel intentionally engineered.
entries.component_notes: Components should feel sharp, compact, and exact; use thin borders, low-radius surfaces, and restrained shadows.

entries.name: Linear Inspired Design System
entries.vibe: Ultra-refined dark precision with subtle violet energy and meticulous product polish.
entries.palette_notes: Use dark charcoal layers with controlled violet accents and quiet separators for depth.
entries.typography_notes: Use compact, crisp typography with clear density management and strong UI labels.
entries.layout_notes: Favor tight but ordered spacing, split panes, and interface density that stays legible.
entries.component_notes: Use understated panels, low-contrast dividers, polished table/list patterns, and motion that rewards precision.

entries.name: Stripe Inspired Design System
entries.vibe: Elegant financial confidence powered by aurora gradients, soft surfaces, and premium detail.
entries.palette_notes: Blend soft purples, blues, and neutrals with gradient lighting used as atmosphere rather than decoration.
entries.typography_notes: Use light-to-regular weight display typography balanced with very readable body text.
entries.layout_notes: Prefer layered sections, floating cards, and clean demo spaces with premium margins.
entries.component_notes: Cards, pricing blocks, and trust banners should feel luminous, polished, and enterprise-ready.

entries.name: Supabase Inspired Design System
entries.vibe: Developer-first dark system with emerald signals, practical clarity, and code-centric messaging.
entries.palette_notes: Use graphite and deep green surfaces with emerald accents for action, confirmation, and brand emphasis.
entries.typography_notes: Mix clean UI typography with monospace accents around code, snippets, and metrics.
entries.layout_notes: Combine docs-like scanning with dashboard modularity and strong callout blocks.
entries.component_notes: Inputs, tabs, and tables should feel utilitarian, clean, and fast to parse.

entries.name: Cursor Inspired Design System
entries.vibe: AI-native dark interface with IDE energy, gradient accents, and fast tool ergonomics.
entries.palette_notes: Use deep graphite with restrained gradients in blue-violet ranges for AI emphasis and focus states.
entries.typography_notes: Use dense, technical UI typography with monospace support for code and commands.
entries.layout_notes: Favor pane-based composition, command areas, and compact controls that still preserve hierarchy.
entries.component_notes: Command bars, chat panes, action lists, and file/navigation rails should feel immediate and sharp.

entries.name: VoltAgent Inspired Design System
entries.vibe: Void-black agent interface with emerald charge, terminal confidence, and futuristic restraint.
entries.palette_notes: Use black and deep graphite with emerald accents, keeping contrast high and ornament low.
entries.typography_notes: Use clean sans UI type with selective monospace for commands, logs, and metrics.
entries.layout_notes: Favor modular panels, operational density, and surfaces that feel like control infrastructure.
entries.component_notes: Status chips, consoles, cards, and quick-action bars should feel active, precise, and machine-ready.

entries.name: Framer Inspired Design System
entries.vibe: Motion-forward black-and-blue design language with bold contrast and creative confidence.
entries.palette_notes: Use black, white, and electric blue accents with gradients reserved for hero surfaces and motion cues.
entries.typography_notes: Use assertive display typography with modern, high-contrast body copy.
entries.layout_notes: Favor dramatic hero sections, asymmetry, and high-contrast blocks that showcase motion.
entries.component_notes: CTAs, feature cards, and media frames should feel kinetic, polished, and high impact.

entries.name: Apple Inspired Design System
entries.vibe: Premium restraint with luminous whitespace, cinematic product framing, and immaculate hierarchy.
entries.palette_notes: Use whites, cool grays, and restrained blacks with color mostly delegated to media or product imagery.
entries.typography_notes: Use large, confident headlines with meticulous spacing and minimal visual noise.
entries.layout_notes: Use wide margins, generous section spacing, and media-led storytelling.
entries.component_notes: Controls and cards should feel extremely refined, minimal, and physically plausible.

entries.name: Spotify Inspired Design System
entries.vibe: Dark entertainment energy with vivid green accents, bold typography, and media-first momentum.
entries.palette_notes: Anchor the system in black and dark gray, then use bright green sparingly for primary action and recognition.
entries.typography_notes: Use bold, expressive typography with strong marketing rhythm.
entries.layout_notes: Favor large media surfaces, stacked content modules, and fast-scanning shelves.
entries.component_notes: Cards, nav rails, and featured content modules should feel immersive and energetic.
